desc:
Welcome to Camper Van! Have fun with your friends, roleplay, customize your avatar, build a trailer, complete events and discover secrets on a road trip as you drive down the world's safest and infinite highway in a supersized RV!🎈. 

[🍂Fall Update]
> 🎃Halloween Theme
> 🚔 New events
> 🎖️More badges
>🛠️ More Trailer furniture (Build your own trailer that saves!)
>👓 Catalog Avatar Editor
>🏡 New locations
>❓ New secrets
+ More! See full list of changes in game.

🎟️ Use code HalloweenUpdate26 for 67 tokens!

📂If you have any suggestions, bug reports or questions, feel free to drop a message on the community forums.
Community: https://www.roblox.com/communities/36076795

👑 Private Server owners can access an admin panel, including setting the time, setting events and running admin commands!
